Victory Day collection at Anjan’s
2016-12-13T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/victory-day-collection-anjans-1329157

To celebrate the month of victory, Anjan's has introduced an entire collection of sari, panjabi, shalwar kameez, fatua, koti etc for both adults and children. The mediums used primarily for the designs are block prints, appliqué, embroidery, screen-print and a mix and match of all the above.

The predominantly red and green collection, signifying freedom of Bangladesh, has been developed keeping in mind the season of winter. The launch of the Victory Day collection by Anjan's had been initiated on the same day as the inauguration of its brand new outlet at Tokyo Square on the 7 December, 2016.

The Victory Day collection is available all month long, at all of 19 outlets of Anjan's throughout the country.
